text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Faster… I need to be faster… I'll never beat Suzuka at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm beginning to sense a dangerous aura about Air Groove during our recent training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling her determination to surpass Silence Suzuka is pushing her to risky extremes.
choice_data_list: (I need to think of some way to get her to relax…)
(I need to think of some way to get her to relax…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, it occurs to me that I haven't been to a shrine yet this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove chewed me out last year about not having any holiday spirit. She'll definitely bite if I mention this to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What are you staring at? Do you have something to say about my running?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking about how I haven't been to a shrine yet this year…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No… It can't be… How could I let this happen?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is way more flustered than I imagined!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I knew these things meant a lot to her, but can she really be this horrified on my behalf?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: HOW HAVE I NOT GONE YET?!
choice_data_list: …Wait, you too?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll never forgive myself! I was so caught up in training that I almost let this celebration pass me by!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why are you just standing there?! We're leaving right this second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I never imagined Air Groove would have forgotten, but it was a happy miscalculation. This should present a good chance for her to relax. We get ready and head out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and I finish giving our respects at a local shrine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This doesn't happen often, but I must thank you. If weren't for your reminder, I would've completely forgotten about it.
choice_data_list: You're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh… This is clear proof of negligence on my part!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I need to up my game! Otherwise, I'm never going to beat Suzuka…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Okay. Let's hurry back. Time is precious, and I need to spend it training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start to panic. I need to nip this in the bud before things get out of hand. But how am I going to get her to take the whole day off?
choice_data_list: Why don't we have some New Year's food?
Why don't we have some New Year's food?
Let's write "I want to get stronger" on a prayer tablet!
Let's get a fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I start to panic. I need to nip this in the bud before things get out of hand. But how am I going to get her to take the whole day off?
choice_data_list: Why don't we have some New Year's food?
Why don't we have some New Year's food?
Let's write "I want to get stronger" on a prayer tablet!
Let's get a fortune slip!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Did you even listen to what I just said? We haven't a moment to lose!
choice_data_list: So you're just going to ignore the New Year's season?
So you're just going to ignore the New Year's season?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I suppose a shrine visit alone isn't enough to constitute a proper New Year's celebration…
choice_data_list: You know how important it is to show some holiday spirit!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't believe you're using my own words against me…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine, I surrender. My lifestyle may indeed have been lacking in balance of late.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's eat something seasonal before we head back. Any ideas?
choice_data_list: How about mochi soup?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Is that the only New Year's food you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and I get some mochi soup before heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to have loosened up a bit. I think the time off did her some good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I want to get stronger?" As always, your phrasing needs some work. Besides, I don't have time to waste on—
choice_data_list: Do you not write prayer tablets for New Year's?
Do you not write prayer tablets for New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Actually, I usually do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Writing out my goals is an effective way to heighten my awareness of them.
choice_data_list: So what are we waiting for?
So what are we waiting for?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I suppose you're right. But let's make this quick.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'd like to retract my earlier statement. I may have been more… on edge lately than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get to it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So tell me. What are you going to write?
choice_data_list: "I hope Air Groove becomes the greatest racer of all time."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You moron… Could you have phrased that any more poorly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and I discuss how to best write our wishes on the wooden prayer tablets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we chat, I notice her expression growing less strained. I let out a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Did you even listen to a word I said? I told you time is of the essence.
choice_data_list: But a shrine visit isn't complete without a fortune.
But a shrine visit isn't complete without a fortune.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I don't… entirely disagree.
choice_data_list: Don't you want to celebrate this holiday properly?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I hate that you're using my own words against me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll placate you just this once. What are you standing around for? Come on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's fortune reads, "You are rushing forward with little regard for your health. Find time to relax."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove takes the words to heart, resolving to focus on the training she really needs to do rather than recklessly racking up session after session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This shift in focus helps to relieve the excessive pressure she had been feeling, leading her back to the path of efficiency.
